palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization. Here's an example of a 255-character long palindrome:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba" - This is a famous English palindrome.

Note: The longest known palindromic prime number is 1008081 (109 digits), which is also the same forwards and backwards, as well as being a prime number.
